ei.title: 2번: Why Your Recorded Voice Sounds Strange
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Many people are embarrassed by the sound of their own voice. It doesn't bother them when they are having a conversation. But they feel uncomfortable when hearing a recording of it. There is actually a scientific explanation for this. We usually hear our own voice while talking to other people, and when we do so, we receive the sound in two different ways. It arrives externally through the air, just like the sound of other people's voices. But it also arrives internally, because it moves through the bones of our skull. On the other hand, when we hear a recording of our voice, the sound only travels through the air. Sound that travels through bone is perceived as being deeper than sound that travels through the air. So we often find that our voice has a higher pitch than what we expected when we hear it on a recording. Our voice is an important part of our identity. Therefore, it is a little upsetting to find out it doesn't sound like what we thought!

② heard: 'when heard a recording'? 여기서 사람들(they)이 직접 녹음을 '듣는' 능동 관계라, 줄인 부사절에서는 현재분사 hearing이 와야 해요. 과거분사 heard(수동)는 틀리므로 hearing으로 고쳐야 해요 ←정답

③ receive(현재동사): 'we receive the sound' 주어 we + 현재동사 — 적절

det.tip: when + -ing = 능동으로 '~할 때' → when hearing a recording

det.korean: that → what (앞에 꾸밈 받을 선행사가 없어 '~하는 것'을 뜻하는 관계대명사 what 필요)

det.korean: deeper → higher (녹음은 뼈 전달이 빠져 예상보다 더 높게 들림)

det.korean: 본문 'Sound that travels through bone is perceived as being deeper than sound that travels through the air'를 바꿔 말한 ③이 일치

questions.passage: Many people are embarrassed by the sound of their own voice. It doesn't bother them when they are having a conversation. But they feel uncomfortable when hearing a recording of it. There is actually a scientific explanation for this. We usually hear our own voice while talking to other people, and when we do so, we receive the sound in two different ways. It arrives externally through the air, just like the sound of other people's voices. But it also arrives internally, because it moves through the bones of our skull. On the other hand, when we hear a recording of our voice, the sound only travels through the air. Sound that travels through bone is perceived as being deeper than sound that travels through the air. So we often find that our voice has a higher pitch than what we expected when we hear it on a recording. Our voice is an important part of our identity. Therefore, it is a little upsetting to find out it doesn't sound like what we thought!
